Name: The Eroded Lord
Information:
**Eroded Lord**

The Eroded Lord is a figure who became a sword saint progenitor seemingly through notoriety, but their fame is part of a dark scheme to acquire power.

**The Tribe of Halte**

Hiding in secret both within and underground in the Itonian Capital are the remains of an army that once served the Itonia family, who were one of the forces struggling for control of Retia during the Provincial War. Halte Itonia, the dwarven king who ruled Mot and Greyrock, served as the head of this powerful dynasty. The Itonian armies were defeated, Halte and his family captured and either executed or imprisoned, and their efforts squashed. Despite this, many of their higher-ups survived and fled, including a silent hádislin warrior who served as Halte’s right-hand man, the Eroded Lord. The Eroded Lord was ordered by Halte to flee the final conflicts of the Provincial War and do everything they had to to preserve the Itonian legacy, and this is precisely what they did.

The Tribe of Halte lay suspended for a time, biding its time while generations of High-Kings and High-Queens passed by, and they made several attempts to retake their city, always failing. The Eroded Lord stood as a silent leader, organizing them while using other subordinates as decoy figureheads, managing to avoid being caught. After their many failures and hundreds of years passing, the Tribe of Halte has become similar to a cult or terrorist cell, and has begun looking for more insidious means to gain the power they need to take back their city.

**The Eroded Lord**

This reclusive hádislin was an inventive arcanist who repurposed ancient technology they found in the Motian countryside, in an old crater that was once a pre-Somnian structure. Unknown to them, it was the remains of an old DGR unit, which they refitted to be a power suit. Their aim was simple: their body was failing them, and they feared early death. Their only goal was to create a means to transfer magical energy into life support, but they accidentally created a system for transforming eidomantic energy into a usable form. Through this, they not only prolonged their life so long as they wore their armor, but also discovered that they could use the suit to amplify their fiendish blood’s power and create sorcerous magic, despite not being a sorcerer naturally.

They lived to research the extent of their power and constantly worked to upgrade their armor, and eventually drew the attention of the Itonian family. They were asked to present their findings at the Itonian Capital, where they reluctantly did so, and the king at the time demanded they surrender their secrets to their armies. The Eroded Lord refused, and battled the enraged king’s forces to attempt to escape - in this escape, they pushed the armor to its limits, and encountered the son of the Itonian king, the future father of Halte Itonia. They spared them when they could have killed them, and the young royal saw them as a heroic figure, and so would later encourage their son to seek out the man and bring him to the capital.

**Loyalist Revenge**

The Eroded Lord spent the next generation hiding from the royals, but responded to summons by the dying king. When asked to protect Halte in the upcoming conflicts that they felt would seize the country, the Eroded Lord accepted on the condition that they hold the same authority as the kings and queens they would serve. Halte agreed, and the two power-hungry individuals eventually drove one another to escalate local conflicts into what would become the Provincial War.

Now, deposed and hiding under the city he once considered his, the Eroded Lord has become a dark and vengeful warrior. They intentionally leaked knowledge of how to replicate their artificial sorcery, but disguised several techniques in them that would cause a small amount of magical energy produced by those using them to be sent back to the Eroded Lord, who stockpiles it within their armor (a new generation of their original armor) to use for themselves. Currently, they believe that finding better materials to create a more powerful suit of armor would lead to their victory, and they have set their sights on the recent emergence of DGRs across Retia.

traits.name: Arcanist Critical
traits.description: The Eroded Lord scores a critical hit on a d20 result of 19 or 20, and when it scores a critical hit they regain a level 1d4 spell slot.

traits.name: Eidomantic Circuitry
traits.description: When the Eroded Lord casts a spell using a spell slot, the next attack it hits with before the start of its next turn deals additional force damage equal to a d10 x the slot level.

traits.name: Freedom of Movement
traits.description: No effect can reduce the Eroded Lord’s movement speed, and it ignores difficult terrain.

traits.name: Spellcasting
traits.description: The Eroded Lord is a 20th-level spellcaster. Their spellcasting ability is Charisma (spell attack +11, spell save DC 19). They have the following spells prepared:
traits.postscript: When they cast any of these spells, the spell level is treated as being twice as high as the spell slot used.

actions.name: Multiaction
actions.description: The Eroded Lord makes three weapon attacks, or makes one weapon attack and casts a spell with a casting time of 1 action.

actions.name: Arcane Fuse Strike
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +12 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (1d10 + 7) bludgeoning damage plus 5 (1d8) force damage.

actions.name: Arcane Fuse Cannon
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +11 to hit, range 30/90 ft., one target. Hit: 19 (2d12 + 6) force damage.

bonus_actions.name: Enhance Abilities (Recharge 5-6)
bonus_actions.description: The Eroded Lord chooses one ability score. It gains advantage on all attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws that use that ability score until the start of their next turn. Its Arcane Fuse Strike uses Strength, and its Arcane Fuse Cannon uses Charisma.

bonus_actions.name: Spiritual Armor (1/Rest)
bonus_actions.description: The Eroded Lord gains 55 (10d10) temporary hit points. If the Eroded Lord scores a critical hit or is hit by one, it regains its use of this feature immediately if it has been spent.

reactions.name: Burdened Mind
reactions.description: When the Eroded Lord would lose concentration, it instead does not.
